ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $ \triangle ABC \cong \triangle DCB$, $ \angle A = 80^\circ$, and $ \angle ACB = 40^\circ$. What is the measure of $ \angle ABD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\because$ $\triangle ABC\cong \triangle DCB$\\
$\therefore$ $\angle DBC=\angle ACB=40^\circ$\\
In $\triangle ABC$\\
$\angle ABC=180^\circ-\angle A-\angle ACB=60^\circ$\\
$\therefore$ $\angle ABD=\angle ABC-\angle DBC=20^\circ$\\
Hence, the answer is: $\boxed{20^\circ}$.
